eval_classification: run eval_classification to compute top-1 and top-5 accuracy for a model and classifier on a data loader
eval_multi_class_classification: run eval_multi_class_classification to compute mAP for multi-label classification using a model and data loader
eval_k400_on_features: run eval_k400_on_features to evaluate a loaded omnivore model on the Kinetics-400 dataset
accuracy: run accuracy to compute top-k classification accuracy from model output logits and ground truth targets
main: run main to load configs via Hydra and evaluate K400 features end to end
